newsitem.title: UK: P&O shares gain as U.S. lawsuit settled.
newsitem.headline: P&O shares gain as U.S. lawsuit settled.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co were among the biggest gainers in the UK market on Wednesday after the company said it had settled a U.S. lawsuit.
"The market has reacted well to news of the settlement," said one dealer.
P&O shares, which tumbled on March 27 as a press report highlighted the lawsuit against its Princess Cruises unit, was up 12-1/2p, or two percent, at 630 by 1409 GMT.

Florida's attorney general said Princess would pay $85,000 in investigative costs and would adopt a new full fare pricing policy, the last cruise operator to settle after the state's attorney general complained cruise lines were misleading passengers on advertised fares. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
